The image shows a coffee leaf with a distinct circular lesion featuring a brown/reddish center surrounded by a lighter halo and yellowish ring — the classic "bird's eye" or "eye-spot" pattern characteristic of Brown Eye Spot (Cercospora coffeicola). Rust would appear as orange/yellow powdery pustules on the underside without the concentric eye-like pattern.
